items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Fathead was playng with another little old band around here called Doug Finley and the Sanctified Fire. A friend of mine, a trumpet player -- an old trumpet player.

ctx.x: records with him, but Cooper did. Let me see, Fathead was playng with another little old band around here called Doug Finley and the Sanctified Fire. A friend of mine, a trumpet player -- an old trumpet player.
Why couldn't you get him for that record you made with...?
